faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist-II (Medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist-II (Medical) recruitment is 02-09-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Research Scientist-II (Medical) post?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist-II (Medical) post at AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have an MBBS / BVSc / BDS with three years post qualification experience, or a Post Graduate Degree (MD/MVSc/MDS/MPH), or a PhD in the relevant field.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Research Scientist-II (Medical) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 40 years, with relaxation available as per AIIMS/ICMR rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist-II (Medical) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 104000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely online through the official AIIMS Delhi website.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Research Scientist-II (Medical) post?
faq.answer: The selection will be based on an interview, which can be conducted offline or online.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from any state apply for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates from all states are eligible to apply, provided they meet the specified eligibility criteria.

faq.answer: The official notification and the online application link can be found in the "Important Links" section of this article.
